payload.supporting_quote: Women with episodic migraine had elevated levels of IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α compared with healthy controls
The IL-6 level in the controls was 8.60 +/- 7.36 pg/mL, which was significantly lower than the patient group using TPM (P = 0.001).
Serum levels of ICAM1 and IL-6 were significantly higher in migraine patients during attacks than in controls (p < 0.05).
Mean IL-6 levels were increased in all three samples of migraineurs versus controls, but did not achieve statistical significance.
